title: Savings Applied at an Early Closing - Credit Builder Accounts Settlement Figure
content:
The savings applied at an early closing of a Credit Builder Accounts account are the closing interest, plus the loan balance, plus the unpaid fees, the total rounded to the cent and not more than the savings balance; the unpaid fees are every late and returned-payment fee charged on the account less every fee waiver and every fee payment booked against them.

## Closing interest

The closing interest is the loan balance times the APR divided by 100 times the interest days divided by 365, rounded to the cent; the interest days are 30 for the month before the oldest unpaid due date plus the calendar days after the oldest unpaid due date up to and including the closing date (the closing date less that due date), a negative count when that due date is still ahead. The interest days are never counted below zero, and the closing interest is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end. Every rounding to the cent here goes to the nearest cent, a half cent or more rounding up.

- **Loan balance:** the unpaid loan principal on the account record.
- **APR:** the account's fixed APR, in percent.
- **Oldest unpaid due date:** the next due date the account record shows.
- **Closing date:** the confirmation date, which is today; closing interest is counted through that date.
- **Unpaid fees:** the total of the account's late-fee and returned-payment fee entries, less the total of its fee waiver and fee payment entries.
- **Savings balance:** the balance of the locked savings certificate.

## Worked figures (hypothetical accounts)

| Item | Account A | Account B | Account C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Loan balance | 500.00 | 500.00 | 900.00 |
| APR | 12.00 | 12.00 | 12.00 |
| Oldest unpaid due date | 10 May | 9 June | 10 May |
| Closing date | 20 May | 5 May | 20 May |
| Interest days | 30 plus 10, that is 40 | 30 less 35, below zero, so 0 | 40 |
| Closing interest | 500.00 times 12.00 divided by 100 times 40 divided by 365: 6.5753..., 6.58 | 0.00 | 11.8356..., 11.84 |
| Late and returned-payment fees charged | 4.00 | 4.00 | 10.00 |
| Fee waivers and fee payments booked | 0.00 | 4.00 | 0.00 |
| Total owed | 510.58 | 500.00 | 921.84 |
| Savings balance | 600.00 | 600.00 | 910.00 |
| Savings applied | 510.58 | 500.00 | 910.00, held to the savings balance |
